services.title: Fusebox & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Modern consumer units are safer and more reliable. We install and upgrade fuseboxes to handle today's demands and meet Building Regulations.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing

about_pullquote: I built this business on honest pricing and turning up when I say I will.
about_para_1: E.B.I Electrician was founded to provide Leicester with reliable, no-nonsense electrical work. For nearly two decades, we've handled everything from midnight emergency callouts to major commercial rewires, earning a reputation for turning up on time, doing the job right, and charging fairly. We're NICEIC certified, which means every job meets Building Regulations and comes with full testing and certification.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us because we listen, explain what's needed without the jargon, and never try to upsell work you don't need. Whether it's a simple repair or a whole-house rewire, we treat your home and business with respect. Fast response times, transparent quotes, and workmanship that lasts — that's the E.B.I promise.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About E.B.I Electrician

reviews.text: Called them at 10pm with a dodgy socket that was sparking. They were round within 45 minutes, found a loose connection in the consumer unit, and fixed it straightaway. Professional, safe, and honest about the cost. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Marcus P.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired after buying a 1960s terrace. They worked around us, kept the place clean, and did a beautiful job. Got the certification done quickly too. Definitely recommend E.B.I.
reviews.author: Angela T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Came out to sort some loose wiring in our shop, checked everything else for free, and gave me a quote for upgrades without any pressure. That's the kind of electrician you want working on your business.
reviews.author: James H.
